description: Fixed, reviewable data policy for the Cowork Test Selector. A focused selection is a fast local feedback aid ONLY. It can never satisfy A7.7, replace collection parity, replace the full regression suite required before a commit, claim that unselected tests would pass, or authorize staging, committing, pushing, merging, or deployment. Pure data: no executable construct, no regular expression, no command, no pytest flag beyond the fixed template, no environment assignment, no machine path, and no credential. A test file whose own imports cannot be read statically is added to every focused selection instead of forcing the whole repository to the full suite; a CHANGED SOURCE file whose imports cannot be read still escalates. Every contract value below is fixed: a policy that disagrees is refused, so no field here can turn the safety inclusion off, exclude a dynamic test, or downgrade an escalation.

collection_count_history.note: These are historical snapshots, never expected values. Collection must be re-measured against the current pinned HEAD every time, and parity compares exact node-ID sets. The Test Selector never invokes collection itself.
